title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.5.42
body_markdown:
* Added: New models (**OpenAI GPT-4.1**, **o3** and **o4-mini**, **Gemini 2.5 Pro**) are available.
* Added: A new setting to toggle auto-scrolling to the bottom of the chat.
* Added: Support for restoring checkpoints and conversation history in Copilot Edits.
* Added: Custom instructions for generating Chat and Git commit messages. Specify these in the **.github/copilot-instructions.md** or **.github/git-commit-instructions.md** files.
* Added: Vision support, enabling to attach and work with images directly in Copilot Chat.
* Fixed: Inline completion provider now uses a human-readable name.
* Fixed: Corrected the signed-in status in the main menu.
* Fixed: Resolved issues with the delete-line shortcut in inline chat.
* Fixed: Removed unused authentication settings.
* Fixed: Various UI improvements and minor bug fixes.
